title: Config
description: Session configuration (§5.2). Drives selector, panel, coordinator, budgets, and runtime knobs. Vendor model identifiers appear only inside `examples/configs/*.yaml`, never in this schema body — the `provider` and `model` enums are intentionally OPEN strings, validated per adapter (rule N4).

schema_version.description: SemVer of this Config schema (§5.1). Pass 4 schemas are `1.0.0`.

session_id.description: Stable identifier for the session; persisted under `runs/<session_id>/`.

originator.description: Identifier for the session originator (user, host, automation). Used as the speaker of the problem_statement message.

problem_statement.description: The natural-language problem submitted to the session. Persisted as the first message of the canonical_transcript.

strategy.description: Selector strategy. CLOSED enum. MVP ships `fixed`; `rules` and `llm` are reserved for v1+.

default_deliberation_panel.description: Ordered list of agent ids forming the deliberation panel. Cross-reference with `agents[].id` is a runtime invariant (§4.1).

selector_budget.description: Budget for the selector LLM call (M4). The schema requires this only when `strategy = llm` (via the conditional below).

agents.description: Per-agent configuration. Each entry binds a persona to a provider/model invocation profile (§2.2 agent definition, Pass 1 rows #22, #40).

coordinator.description: Coordinator agent configuration. Same shape as a panel agent; distinguished by position (it appears here, not in `agents`).

budget.description: Session-level budget block. Hard-cap semantics in §4.7.

max_total_tokens.description: Cumulative token cap across all provider invocations.

selector_budget.description: Convenience shorthand mirroring selector.selector_budget (M4); cross-consistency is a runtime check.

runtime.description: Runtime knobs. Semantics in §4.5, §4.6, §4.7, §4.9. The `default` keyword on each property carries the default; descriptions point to the §4 owner.

max_branch_depth.description: Maximum branch_depth a fork MAY reach (§4.7).

max_deferred_queue_length.description: Bounded length of the deferred_request queue (§4.6).

max_deferred_drains_per_round.description: Max queued requests drained per round open (§4.6).

per_agent_retry_budget.description: Retry count per invocation before a single-invocation failure is unrecoverable (§4.9; mechanism in §6 Pass 5).

synthesize_on_terminate.description: If true, the runtime attempts synthesis once on non-finalize terminate paths (§4.8).

on_budget_exceeded.description: Policy applied when a hard cap fires (§4.7, §8.2). CLOSED enum for MVP. `stop` — terminate with the matched reason (the only MVP value). `degrade` and `escalate` are reserved §12 Roadmap values and MUST NOT be accepted by an MVP-conformant runtime; the enum is closed at `stop` until a future MINOR schema bump opens it.

observability_level.description: Verbosity of the observability metric set computed for the session (§7.9, §7.10). CLOSED enum. `mvp` — the MUST-set in §7.9 only. `verbose` is reserved for v1+ when the SHOULD-set in §7.10 is wired in; MVP-conformant runtimes MAY accept the value but are not required to compute the additional metrics.

max_tool_iterations.description: Maximum number of internal tool-call iterations the adapter is permitted per single provider invocation (§6.4). Promoted from adapter-internal cap to a runtime-visible knob in Pass 6 so operators can tune it without recompiling the adapter. The runtime forwards this value to every adapter that supports internal-loop tool calling; adapters that do not implement an internal loop ignore it. Default 8 (matches §6.4 prose).

agent_config.title: AgentConfig
agent_config.description: Configuration for a single agent (panel member or coordinator). The `provider`/`model` enums are OPEN strings — vendor identifiers belong to examples, never to this schema (rule N4).

persona_ref.description: Reference to the persona profile bound to this agent. Either an inline Persona object or a string id of a registered persona (resolution is a host concern).

provider.description: Provider adapter id (OPEN string). Concrete vendor identifiers live in `examples/configs/*.yaml`, not in this schema body (rule N4).

model.description: Model identifier within the provider (OPEN string). Concrete vendor model strings live in `examples/configs/*.yaml`, not in this schema body (rule N4).

reasoning_effort.description: Optional reasoning-effort hint passed to the provider. OPEN string at the schema level; the adapter interprets vendor-specific values.

tools.description: Tool registrations for this agent. Tool schemas are finalized in §6 Pass 5; MVP allows opaque tool descriptors.

output_requirements.description: Per-agent override of the persona's output_requirements (Pass 1 row #24b). When absent, falls back to the bound persona's output_requirements.

retry_budget.description: Per-agent override of runtime.per_agent_retry_budget. When absent, falls back to the runtime default.
